description.p: ASUSCraft is a community-built app that brings the hardware information and controls of an ASUS laptop into one window. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by ASUS.

ul.li: Battery charge limits and charging modes
GPU MUX switching (Hybrid and Ultimate modes)
OLED-friendly display dimming and eye-care modes

description.p: Privileged changes go through a small whitelist-only helper run with pkexec. Controls your laptop does not expose stay disabled.
The Flatpak distribution and the separately packaged host agent, with cross-desktop-environment support.

ul.li: ASUSCraft now ships as a Flatpak; the hardware controls and the host commands are reached through the host agent (asuscraft-agent)
The host agent is unprivileged: the whitelist-only helper and its polkit action are unchanged
The night light reads and writes the GNOME colour schema (enabled, colour temperature, schedule) and keeps the KDE path
The touchpad uses the desktop's own setting; the obsolete xinput path is gone
The desktop-environment probe is cached at startup and unsupported controls are greyed out automatically
System Manager: health overview, CPU/RAM monitoring, Smart Recommendations, Quick Actions, health history
Software Center: installed apps, pending updates, driver and diagnostics overview
Fix memory leak in health-history directory creation
Fix stale helper exit code on spawn failure

description.p: System Manager and Software Center pages; expanded System Diagnosis.
GPU MUX double-write fix; post-reboot switch verification; honest Integrated status.
Colored app icon; RPM packaging fixes; security hardening of polkit helper.
First packaged release, with RPM and Debian packages.

ul.li: Separate hardware backlight slider next to OLED dimming
OLED dimming via the bundled Soft Brightness Plus extension
Layout, colours and fonts in the style of MyASUS
